import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX = 1 << 20;
    static int n, mask_limit, answer;
    static int[] p1_acc = new int[MAX];
    static int[] p2_acc = new int[MAX];
    static int[][] grid_flag = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] grid_a = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] h_mask = new int[10][10][10];

    static int power(int base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % MOD;
            }
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int inverse(int x) {
        return power(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean verify_triplet(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] arr = {x, y, z};
        int[] perm = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (grid_flag[arr[perm[0]]][1] != 0 && grid_flag[arr[perm[1]]][2] != 0 && grid_flag[arr[perm[2]]][3] != 0)
                return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(perm));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] perm) {
        int i = perm.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && perm[i] >= perm[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = perm.length - 1;
        while (perm[j] <= perm[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        swap(perm, i, j);
        reverse(perm, i + 1, perm.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start++, end--);
        }
    }

    static void dfs_first(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (verify_triplet(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = 1;
                            while (X == i || X == j || X == k) X++;
                            int Y = X + 1;
                            while (Y == i || Y == j || Y == k) Y++;
                            int Z = Y + 1;
                            while (Z == i || Z == j || Z == k) Z++;
                            state |= h_mask[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            p1_acc[state] = (p1_acc[state] + P) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        grid_flag[x][y] = 1;
        if (y == 3) {
            dfs_first((int)((long) P * grid_a[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs_first((int)((long) P * grid_a[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        grid_flag[x][y] = 0;
        if (y == 3) {
            dfs_first((int)((long) P * (MOD + 1 - grid_a[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs_first((int)((long) P * (MOD + 1 - grid_a[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs_second(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (verify_triplet(i, j, k))
                            state |= h_mask[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            p2_acc[state] = (p2_acc[state] + P) % MOD;
            answer = (int)((MOD + 1 - answer + (long) p1_acc[mask_limit ^ state] * P) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        grid_flag[x][y - 3] = 1;
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs_second((int)((long) P * grid_a[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfs_second((int)((long) P * grid_a[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        grid_flag[x][y - 3] = 0;
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs_second((int)((long) P * (MOD + 1 - grid_a[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            dfs_second((int)((long) P * (MOD + 1 - grid_a[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                grid_a[i][j] = (int)((long) val * inverse(100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            grid_a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    h_mask[i][j][k] = 1 << total++;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs_first(1, 1, 1);
        mask_limit = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= mask_limit; j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    p1_acc[j] = (p1_acc[j] + p1_acc[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        dfs_second(1, 1, 4);
        answer = (MOD + 1 - answer) % MOD;
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
